profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Roadie
profile.summary:
Software Engineer knowledgeable in backend Go microservices, Java OOP fundamentals, Python. As well as frontend development in Typescript/Javascript and React. 

Current goals and passions are in innovative and disruptive technologies. Always open to learning and sharing my own knowledge!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Stack: Go, Typescript, React, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Python/Pytest, Playwright

- Collaborate in an agile team of 10 to deliver features for the business’s highest priority project to improve the car titling and registration process on the e-commerce funnel across several distributed microservices

- Iterate backend infrastructure to support the automatic requests of required documentation from customers to finalize their car buying process reducing the overall total time per purchase from 61 days to 29 days, resulting in cost savings of $2.8M per year

- Leverage horizontally scalable, highly asynchronous, and event driven architecture using Kafka across 8+ distributed systems and microservices to process 20,000+ records per hour

- Acquire and ingest data from third party vendors with the use of APIs to display transaction statuses and progression on customers’ account, reducing call volume by 20%

- Participate in architecture design planning to tackle dependencies, road blocks, and optimal approaches for new feature implementations

- Demonstrate deep understanding of codebase, system architecture, and production worthy code by fixing production bugs and implementing stakeholder requests

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Tech Stack: Typescript, React, Go, Python/Pytest, Cypress, PostgreSQL

-	Architected UI automation framework using Cypress/Typescript to establish production monitoring of core services as well as ensuring stability of lower environment in a CI/CD pipeline

-	Formulated a programmatic approach to verifying third party integrations, such as OAuth 2.0 to support User Authentication using Google and Apple sign-in

-	Built and improved libraries and tooling in areas such as performance testing, integration testing, regression testing, and API testing using Pytest/Python

-	Revamped internal repositories by including SQL queries to validate and cleanup data on all databases

-	Incorporated changes to frontend codebase to include static data attributes to HTML elements to increase UI automation stability and ease of maintenance

-	Participated in code reviews to ensure best practices in performance, scalability, and customer experience are met

-	Oversaw routine performance load tests to validate whether the infrastructure can sustain a 100x increase in traffic from TV advertisements during major broadcasts (NFL Superbowl, NBA finals, etc...)

-	Provided mentorship to other team members to help advance their careers and contribute to hands on development on frontend/backend codebases, or improve automation practices

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Involved in research receiving $3M/year in funding that leads to major technological accomplishments such as: inventions of chromium-based forsterite, cunyite, and emerald lasers; fluorescence and excitation biopsy techniques for medical diagnostics; and optical biomedical imaging techniques.

-	Leveraged MATLAB programming skills to facilitate data extraction and streamline plotting and visualizing outputs from multiple lasers. Greatly reduced time required to analyze relevant data by offering an automated approach

-	Operated intricate industrial lasers costing $100,000+ including the Raman Spectrometer to gather relevant data for publications such as emissions, absorption, and fluorescence of materials used for patent applications 
 
-	Ensured proper functionality and maintenance of instruments in the lab.

company.name: Research Foundation of The City University of New York

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
-	Administered the daily operations of a lab consisting of 50 computers and laptops, and several printers, by troubleshooting network issues, performing routine backups and software updates for use by 900+ end users 

-	Oversaw users, computer accounts and their access to network resources in Active Directory of entire faculty

-      Managed department inventory of all monitors, printers, desktops, and laptops.

volunteerExperiences.description:
(Description is high level to avoid NDA violation)

Competed in a contest against industry professionals hosted by Bank of America to build cutting edge and innovative products or evolve existing technologies for Bank of America/Merrill Lynch and its consumers. 

- Architected a web application that advises stock traders on whether to buy/keep or sell/short a certain stock based on a Machine Learning algorithm that uses historical stock data as well as natural language processing + sentiment news analysis in a team of 3.

-       Established an ingenious and elegant UI using React + Material-UI

-	Showcased the product to 1,000+ viewers tuning in online worldwide as well as a panel of judges on-site

Collaborated in a team of 5 fellow volunteers to build a technological solution in 24 hours for non-profit organization called "Scholars at Risk" which reaches out to individuals residing in oppressive countries where they feel their ideas/publications are at risk of being condemned by authorities.  

- 	Assembled a well-balanced team schedule and assigned roles based on everyone’s strengths in various stacks 

-	Revamped and introduced the foundations of a secure website for professional scholars facing oppression and danger in various countries, using Flask as well as HTML, CSS, Bootstrap for UI, and Firebase for backend

projects.title: Skinnefy
projects.description:
Skinnefy aims to make self diagnosis for skin diseases more accessible by harnessing the power of artificial intelligence.

-	Devise a React Native app to identify skin diseases from 10 different classifications and their treatments by taking a picture of the affected area
-	Overhaul AWS Sagemaker’s Image Classification algorithm that uses a Residual Deep Convolutional Neural Network and customize its hyperparameters to train images from S3 buckets and maximize validation accuracy
-	Launch an endpoint to fetch real-time results from the server by sending HTTP Post requests from the app 
-       Integrate Firebase database for relevant information regarding different diseases as well as handling the user authentication.
